Free features should be completely removed and only allow you to read tabs. Additionally, there are not enough advertisements. reviews.title: Dont read old reviews, ruined by ai
reviews.text:
Looking at any review pre 2024 i can imagine this app was pretty good but genuinely every song i tried to learn with this app that is either apparently not popular enough to get a human to do it is done by ai, which i find crazy because the exact songs im looking for are done perfectly fine on every other app ive tried

The sounds were just blatantly wrong, you could play it to a random person whose never even heard the song your trying to play before and they could still be able to tell it sounded weird

Its a shame because the app's interface is actually really nice (if you get over the 1 million and 1 paid for features that they guilt you into wanting by saying "beginners learn __% faster with this", but thats a whole other issue

Im sure its fine for the most popular songs but if you are trying to learn anything that hasnt been a top 40 hit in the last 10 years you are much better off elsewhere

reviews.title: I love the mobile website, HATE the mobile app
reviews.text: Title says it all. I am going to delete the app bc, unlike most website/app combos (Reddit, Yelp, etc), Songsterr opens the app automatically rather than asking first. There’s no way to stay on the mobile website; you’re forced into the app, killing whatever music app you’re already listening to, forcing you to watch ads you can’t close, hobbling your ability to search for things, and making it harder to do things that are simple on the website, like switching to a synth track.  It’s rare for me to like a mobile website better than an app but in this case, that’s where I’m at.

reviews.title: Love the app, but…
reviews.text:
I love this app. I use it every day. But the two main things I have a problem with the most are the pop ups once I’ve started a tab , and the ads that take a large portion of the bottom of the screen up. I downloaded the app thinking it was better than the version you can just pull up on the web , but it’s not. It’s the same in pretty much every single way. If those ad’s and pop ups weren’t there , I probably would spend money to get better service with it. But I mean come on, ads are out of control in every single major app you find these days. I tend to just pull up sheet music a lot bc I cannot seamlessly flow thru ONE song without a disturbance   Thanks for the app of course , it’s amazing , but the little things could make it THE BEST   

-Dillon
